column3: Manami Route ・ Just Like a Galge
Lunchtime.
Probably like many other people, I was also anticipating lunchtime. I may be studying for University exams, but we all need a break, right?
...*grunt*, huff...
...Why are you dragging a chair over here??
Eh? But... when you eat lunch, you have to sit down right?
That's not what I meant...
Ah, maybe because she's my girlfriend now, she's the type who wants to eat together?
Ugh... Our classmates looking at us...  Seems like, once again, this is turning into a Galge. This is embarrassing...
There we go.
What Manami pulled out was a cute little bento box.
Aaand～, Kyou-chan, This one's for you!
Ehhh?!
This one's for Kyou-chan.
For me?! This? You brought me a bento?
On the top of the desk, next to Manami's bento, was another one twice as large.
I made this for you～
Wha-wha-wha, what is this all of a sudden?
...Eh? Is something wrong?
N-Not wrong! But it's... I...
...See?
Ah... I see...
And like, when you came to wake me up this morning, didn't you ask my mom?
Umm... I was just so ecstatic I didn't even think about it...
On the desk, there was another bento. The one my mother made.
I-I guess I should have been more careful... Sorry... I should have checked first...
E-Even if Kyou-chan's a boy, eating two bentos is too much.. Ehehe, then this is...
What the heck? Why does she seem like she's on the verge of tears, but laughing too?
Manami, wait a minute.
Waaaaait just a minuteeeee!!
W-Whoa?! Akagi?! Where did you come from?
I've been watching the whole time! Going all out with that bright-eyed and bushy-tailed lovey-dovey garbage! You two are THE hottest gossip in class!
Y-yeah, I could feel everyone's eyes, but...
Also, Kousaka! You just said something really rude!
When did I say something rude?
Hey, Kousaka. You've played games, right? So you should know what to say at times like this! For example, the one you bought: "Big brother's
underpan-...".
Hhmmnnghhh! Hmmmnghr! Hmgrrgrgr!
It can't be, did you forget about our friendship pledge? Come on, old pal!
...??  Eh, what happened? You two fighting?
Nah, don't worry about it. Everything's fine! We're on surprisingly good terms!
H-Hey! Kousaka! What I'm trying to say is, right now you're breaking the flag!
F-Flag?
Right! Isn't this the kind of situation that only happens once in a lifetime?! Don't miss out on your 【Memories of Youth】!
M-Memories of Youth?
Exactly! What the heck, dude! Why does this happen only to you, Kousakaaaaaa?!
A-Are you crying? Are you going to cry?!
That's a girl's homemade bento; moreover, Tamura-san's! There's sure to be octodogs in there!
Ha... uh, uuuh.
Don't let your guard down now! Nori! HEART SHAPED NORI!
Shut up, idiot!
I-I'm begging you... Let me feel the warmth of youth as well! This bento... let me have it!
Ehh? No way, Akagi. This is my bento!
Kyo-Kyou-chan...?
...Ughh, B-But, Kousaka... You already have one!
Hmph. That one is also mine!
What... the hell...?
I'll devour them both! I won't let you have any of it!
...Haha, look at me trying to be all cool.
As far as I could tell, Manami's bento is huge. And I know for a fact that my mother's bento is also gigantic.
But... Right? "I'll gladly eat both," is what being a man's all about, right?
Akagi. I have one piece of advice for you.
W-What?
The cafeteria. If you don't hurry, there won't be any left, y'know?
HAAH!!  AAAAAHHHH!
Sorry for that. Now, shall we continue our lunch?
Yes, Kyou-chan.
The lid opens with a *click*.
Ohhh... There's really octodogs!
And if it turns out she mixed up salt and sugar, then this is definitely gonna feel like a Galge...
There's no way Manami would have terrible specs like that. Anway, what should I try first?
Om, mmm, mmm, mmm mmm.
How is it...?
...This is so good!
R-Really?
Ahhh, not letting Akagi get any was definitely the best decision!
I-It's fine if you want to give some to Akagi-kun too...
That'd just be a waste. Okay. Now onto the other one.
Eh..? I-It wasn't tasty after all?
Nah, it's different. First, I'll take care of my mom's.
Filled to the brim with white rice. Mountainous amounts of seemingly-calorie-packed side dishes everywhere.
Thanks for the food!
T-Thanks for the food...
Om, *cough* *gulp*. *huff*... haaaaa
Kyou-chan, you shouldn't eat too fast! You'll choke.
*gulp* *gulp*, mmm-just-fine-mmm *gulp*
Don't force yourself.  It's fine if you don't finish mine, okay?
Ah, that ain't gonna happen!
Kyou-chan?
You took the time to make it for me, so there's no way I'm letting it go to waste.
...Kyo, Kyou-chan.
Manami, aren't you gonna eat your own bento?
I-I will!  I'm fine, it's just, you know...
Do you have a stomachache?
No... That's not it...
I'm just... really happy...
Huh? But I've barely touched your bento.
Yes, but even so, I'm glad. Ehehe～
Thus I boldly attacked the two massive bentos.
It was a fierce battle. Seriously.
But, it was "soooo delicious"!
The bento Manami made for me had Tonkatsu and Shiso leaves; it had a distinct "homey" feeling, like I was already a member of the Tamura family.
Thanks for th-*burp*-meal
Yeah. You're welcome!
